question_text: The American Revolution had many important events. Name one.

official_answers.text: Washington Crossing the Delaware (Battle of Trenton)

why_it_matters.text: The Revolution wasn't won in a single battle. It was years of small victories, brutal defeats, and near-disasters. Bunker Hill proved Americans could fight. The Declaration of Independence gave them a reason to fight. Saratoga and Valley Forge tested whether they could keep fighting. Yorktown finally won the war.

fun_fact.text: On Christmas night 1776, Washington led 2,400 freezing soldiers across the icy Delaware River in a snowstorm. They marched 9 miles to surprise the Hessians (German mercenary fighters) soldiers at Trenton early the next morning. The Continental Army was nearly destroyed at that point. The victory saved the Revolution.
